en-US.shortDescription: Ask how someone living alone has been this week, in plain language.
en-US.fullDescription:
Ask "how has my mum been this week?" and Wick answers in plain words: who came to the door, whether the carer visited, and whether anything was unlike a usual week.

Wick is for the family of someone who lives alone. A television in their home runs the Wick app and shows them calm cards, never in the middle of a programme, only at a natural break. A Ring doorbell tells Wick when someone is at the door.

What you can do:
• Hear how the week went, and what was different from usual
• Check whether a regular visitor, such as a carer, came today
• Put a short note on their television and hear their one-button reply
• Tell them you are coming to visit

The person at home is in charge. They see their own week before anyone else can read it, they choose who in the family is allowed, and nothing about health, money or relationships is ever passed on.

Before you start: you link a Wick account, the home needs a Fire TV running the Wick app, and the person who lives there must allow you from their television.
examplePhrases: how has my mum been this week
